notes: Scale and method as the site describes it: America First Foundation grades current incumbents against an America First policy framework on stand-alone bills in three domains, immigration, trade and foreign policy, from the 117th, 118th and 119th Congresses, with activity counted through June 30, 2026. Simple and concurrent resolutions and bills without published GPO text are excluded. Actions are sponsorships, cosponsorships and recorded final passage votes where available. Each bill is scored 0 to 100 for alignment with the framework; supporting aligned bills or opposing misaligned bills raises a member's evaluation and the reverse lowers it. Bills with little bearing may get reduced weight or be dropped. Israel, the Middle East and U.S. military commitments there get extra weight. Some areas, such as Western Hemisphere, Russia and Ukraine and the Indo-Pacific, are reward only, so members holding a competing position are not penalized. Member pages show a Total grade plus separate Immigration, Foreign Policy and Trade grades; this file records only the Total grade. The site publishes no letter grade cutoffs and no aggregation formula. 'aligned' of 'total' is the site's 'N of M actions aligned with America First positions'. Grades seen: C+, C, C-, D+, D, D-, F and 'Ungraded'. No A or B grades appear; C+ is the highest, and Bernie Moreno is the only member with it. 'Ungraded' members are listed by the site with no N of M figure; aligned and total are null for them. Collection: the listing shows at most 24 cards; page, state and chamber query parameters are ignored. The site search q= parameter matching state or name, plus sort=name and sort=tenure, was used to enumerate all members. Values were read through WebFetch summaries. 90 records were confirmed by a second independent listing read with 0 differences, and 20 more against member pages with 0 differences. One early Texas listing read had digit errors and was thrown out and re-read. The rest have a single read. Verification stopped when the web fetch hourly rate limit was hit. 4 roster members were not found on the site under any search: James Gallagher CA-1, Aisha Wahab CA-14, Everton Blair Jr. GA-13 and Darline Graham SC senator.
